entities.summary: Elías Antonio "Tony" Saca González is a Salvadoran politician, businessman, and journalist who was President of El Salvador from 2004 to 2009 as a member of the Nationalist Republican Alliance (ARENA). He is currently serving a minimum 10-year prison sentence on corruption charges.
